title: Show that the four-vertex far numerators do not share a positive root
body:
## Summary
- On the length-9 width-2 arc `{0,1,2,3}`, the path entry from 1 to 2 gives far numerators with roots `241/8` and `161/648`. No value zeros both directions.
- At `161/648` one Schur direction is zero and the other is `-605/80656`. The row gap is `101/162`, the bandwidth stays 4, and the inverse norms `1854891296/1028005865` sit inside `162/61` and `75330/3721`.
- The selected κ is unchanged.
